title: showcase: three Chart Gallery dataset measure labels (Projects, Tasks, Total Budget) have no zh-CN translation (examples half of #32158)
body:
domain:ui#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAmxB38cjBXwr9FZGyt

Carries item 5 of #32158; #32158 keeps items 4, 7b and 8 (the `ui/**` half), and its server half went to its own card. Filing gate: ④ a per-layer child of #32158, whose own gate is ③ (the maintainer's 「立卡处理」 on the 2026-11-10 full-platform test run, `qa#1`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason:** zh-CN users of the showcase dashboards read English KPI subtitles; the showcase is the product demo for that market (from #32158).

**Reader:** triage first touch; lands in `examples/app-showcase`. Located by the `domain:ui#3` card thread on `origin/main` `171cf6d9` (read in code).

- The subtitles are dataset measure labels in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/datasets/chart-gallery.dataset.ts`: `showcase_project_metrics` `project_count`, `budget_sum`; `showcase_task_metrics` `task_count`.
- Fix: add zh-CN `datasets.<dataset>.measures.<measure>.label` for those three in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` (only `done_count` / `done_rate` are there today), and shrink `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` accordingly.

**Duplicate check:** `is:issue is:open repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack showcase dataset measure label zh-CN` (65 hits, none on these measures: the top results are seat posts).
